fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects possible DLL hijacking of dal_keepalives.dll by looking for suspicious image loads, loading this DLL from unexpected locations.
fields.name: Possible DLL Hijacking of dal_keepalives.dll
fields.query: event.type="ModuleLoad" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\dal_keepalives.dll" and (not (module.path in ("c:\program files\audinate\shared files\*","c:\program files (x86)\audinate\shared files\*")))))
